import pandas as pd

# List of source file paths as given
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/training_8.csv"
]

# According to operation_history, UNION operation on Source9_88_0 to Source9_88_8
# Note: Source9_88_9 is not included in the UNION operation per the operation_history

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and types
    # Target schema: ['admit': int, 'gre': int, 'gpa': float, 'prestige': int]
    # Convert columns to correct types explicitly
    df = df[['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']]  # select columns explicitly
    df['admit'] = df['admit'].astype(int)
    df['gre'] = df['gre'].astype(int)
    df['gpa'] = df['gpa'].astype(float)
    df['prestige'] = df['prestige'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Perform UNION (concatenation) of all these DataFrames
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_88/target_multisource.csv"
union_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
